verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs give users controls over training use. Keep Activity can be turned off at any time [gemini-docs-31]. Using audio, Gemini Live video and screenshares to train generative AI models is framed as something the user chooses to allow [gemini-docs-37]. Another doc states chats and uploaded files won't be human-reviewed or used to improve generative AI models [gemini-docs-38]. missing for 10: an explicit doc snippet tying the Keep Activity toggle to exclusion from model training, clarity on which account types the no-training guarantee covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out works.
